best_for: Novelists and students on Windows or Linux who write better with nothing on screen but the page, and who like a daily word goal to hit.

points.title: The page and nothing else
points.text: The toolbar and menus stay hidden until you move the mouse to an edge of the screen. Themes set the font, colors and a background image, so the room looks the way you want.

points.title: Goals keep you honest
points.text: Set a daily goal and check a progress dialog to see how you are doing. Live statistics and timers that alert you when they finish help you write in fixed sprints.

points.title: Picks up where you stopped
points.text: When you reopen it, your work in progress reloads with the cursor where you left it. Multiple documents and saved sessions let you keep chapters apart.

points.title: Free, with tips welcome
points.text: FocusWriter is free under the GPL 3. The author takes optional tips through PayPal.

points.title: No AI in the project
points.text: The 1.9.1 changelog adds a documented policy that prohibits the use of AI, and a strict mode that turns off unsafe Qt APIs.

points.title: No current Mac download
points.text: The author's site offers Windows 10 x64 downloads, installer and portable, plus Linux. There is no macOS download on the page. This site keeps 10 Windows versions, which install machine-wide. The Linux Flatpak is verified on Flathub as published by the author, and Linux lists only the current release.
